description: Align or distribute items relative to each other, a key object, the margins, the page or the spread, optionally with a fixed spacing (Align panel; Align and Distribute shortcuts)

align.description: Align Objects: which edges or centres to line up

alignTo.description: Align To: the items themselves (default), a key object, the margins, the page or the spread

distribute.description: Distribute Objects by edges or centres, or Distribute Spacing (horizontal_space, vertical_space)

keyObject.description: Id of the key object, for alignTo key_object; defaults to the selection's key object when the target is the selection. With a selection target it also becomes the selection's key object

spacing.description: Use Spacing: a fixed distance between the items (mm) when distributing

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: align_items
title: Align Items
